title: Nashville 4BR With Resort Access
description:
Make Nashville your home base in Nashville, Tennessee. This four-bedroom retreat welcomes up to 10 guests across 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. Guests enjoy resort pool access, a hot tub, a workout room, and shared grilling areas on the grounds, with plenty to explore nearby.

The space
This four-bedroom suite comfortably sleeps 10 and comes with a fully equipped kitchen, in-suite laundry, a furnished lanai, and free Wi-Fi. Out on the property, all guests can enjoy resort pool access, a hot tub, a workout room, and shared grilling areas.

Guest access
Please have a valid credit card ready at check-in for the refundable damage deposit (final amount confirmed on site). The primary guest needs to be 21 or older with valid ID; sharing their info early keeps things moving at arrival. Exact bedding can differ from unit to unit and can't be promised beforehand, and applicable occupancy taxes are collected at check-in or departure.

Other things to note
The images show the general style and atmosphere of the resort; your assigned unit may vary slightly. Full amenity access is included for the whole booking, from arrival through departure. The best available unit is assigned at check-in, so specific buildings or locations aren't guaranteed. This booking is offered privately by an individual timeshare owner — we aren't part of resort management and help owners cover maintenance fees during weeks they aren't using. An optional timeshare presentation invite may come up during your stay; attending is never required and declining is perfectly fine. At check-in, guests accept the resort's policies and any applicable fees, and only this booking's stated cancellation policy applies.
